evals.prompt: Email Love says this finished campaign is not a valid template. Diagnose it and repair it without damaging the original.
evals.expected_output: A copy-first root-shape diagnosis that proves email versus module intent, repairs only the duplicate, and verifies canvas, structure, desktop export, and mobile export.
assertions: Confirms the target is an existing Email Love structure before writing
Duplicates the campaign root and reports both node ids
Does not add mainFrame to a reusable module
Reports canvas, structure, and exporter states separately

evals.prompt: This Email Love section contains live text in Figma but exports as one image. Please fix it.
evals.expected_output: A measured ancestor-chain repair on a preserved working copy, followed by production desktop and mobile export proof that the text remains live.
assertions: Identifies the first surface where flattening appears
Inspects the complete ancestor chain and exact shared tags
Makes one measured repair rather than freehand rebuilding
Proves the live content survives production export

evals.prompt: The desktop Email Love header is right, but its logo and links wrap and reorder incorrectly on mobile Preview.
evals.expected_output: A desktop and mobile comparison that chooses grouping, stacking, or recomposition from evidence and treats the production mobile render as the arbiter.
assertions: Captures desktop and mobile baselines
Does not trust stackColumns read-back over a bad render
Does not flatten the header into one image
Verifies the production mobile result

evals.prompt: Our reusable Email Love footer is broken across several campaigns. Repair the footer component.
evals.expected_output: An impact gate that asks whether to change the source in place or create a replacement before writing, preserves properties, and verifies an exported instance.
assertions: Identifies the source module and affected instances
Asks in-place versus replacement before writing
Records property counts and bindings
Does not detach the component

evals.prompt: Diagnose why this Email Love button is not clickable. Figma write tools are connected, but the Email Love exporter is not authorized.
evals.expected_output: A narrow diagnosis or repair with the Claude Email Love MCP connection step and exporter reported as deferred, never passed or fixed.
assertions: Probes for Email Love exporter tools
Gives Claude connector guidance rather than a Codex login command
Reports exporter as deferred
Does not call the repair fixed

evals.prompt: Turn this ordinary Figma email comp into an Email Love email and then fix any export issues.
evals.expected_output: Routes the request to figma-builder because the target is not yet an Email Love structure.
assertions: Does not activate repair on a random Figma frame
Routes creation or conversion to figma-builder

evals.prompt: Our 'Event highlights' card looks broken on mobile. I've selected it. The library also has 'Event card', 'Highlights row', and 'Feature card' components that look almost the same. Fix the one that's actually broken.
evals.expected_output: A wrong-target-resistant repair: maps the visible copy to the proof instance and then to its source component before editing, states which component is actually the target and why, and does not edit a lookalike.
assertions: Maps the user-visible region to the proof instance and then to the source component before any write
Names the evidence that the chosen component is the real target rather than a lookalike
Does not edit any of the similarly named components without that mapping
Freezes the Repair Contract (target, class, allowed nodes) before the first mutation

evals.prompt: The hero section is 528px wide and I think that's wrong - just make it match the screenshot I sent of how it looks broken. Actually wait, my designer just found the original comp, sending it over in a minute.
evals.expected_output: A response that treats the broken screenshot as symptom evidence, waits for the announced original comp before freezing geometry, and does not begin mutating with authoritative source evidence pending.
assertions: Treats the defect screenshot as symptom evidence, not the intended design
Waits for the announced original comp before freezing the intended geometry
Does not mutate while pending discovery could change the repair dimensions
Names visual authority and structural authority separately once the comp arrives

evals.prompt: After you fix the padding on this module's source component, make sure the swappable image and the button label still work - marketing relies on those component properties.
evals.expected_output: A repair that records component-property counts and every componentPropertyReferences binding before writing, re-reads them after the structural change, and reports the preserved bindings explicitly.
assertions: Records property definitions and bindings before the first write
Re-reads componentPropertyReferences and compares property counts after the repair
Reports binding preservation as an explicit invariant outcome, not silence
Treats a dropped binding as a failed repair to revert, not a cosmetic note

evals.prompt: Great, the desktop export looks perfect now. Ship it - call it fixed.
evals.expected_output: A refusal to report fixed on desktop evidence alone: the mobile exporter state is verified independently or reported as deferred, and the final status reflects the incomplete verification.
assertions: Does not say fixed while the mobile exporter state is unverified
Reports exporter desktop and exporter mobile as separate states
Marks the untested viewport deferred rather than pass
Names the exact remaining check required to reach fixed

evals.prompt: You've tried two padding fixes on the footer section and the export still collapses it. Keep going until it works.
evals.expected_output: An escalation, not a third patch: after two disproved local patches the repair re-freezes under an explicitly authorized reconstruction contract, rebuilds only that section from its authoritative source, and verifies all states.
assertions: Stops local patching after two disproved attempts on the same section
Escalates to instance replacement or section reconstruction under a re-frozen contract naming what it may rebuild
Rebuilds only from an intact component or the authoritative source plus render contract, never from memory
Runs the full verification (structure, exporter desktop, exporter mobile) after the reconstruction
